title: Concept: Lockfile entries without a SHA-2 integrity value
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that carries no SHA-2 integrity value in the lockfile, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The install verifies nothing about the bytes it downloads, so a substituted tarball from a compromised registry or network path is accepted as the reviewed package.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The install verifies nothing about the bytes it downloads, so a substituted tarball from a compromised registry or network path is accepted as the reviewed package.
